commands.name: placeholders
commands.description: Show, list or explain your placeholders; or say in any words what to add, change or remove

tools.name: list_placeholders
tools.description: List every placeholder, one entry per name: token, layer (plugin | global | project | global-legacy | project-legacy), files (the user files per layer; both layers when it is in both), plan (add | none), description, its text and its plan-mode text. Call it first before creating, changing, removing or showing one. To show placeholders, print the requested ones verbatim; /placeholders show ++<name> also prints them instantly.

tools.name: save_placeholder
tools.description: Never call this tool before the user answered your one AskUserQuestion about this exact save in this turn, even when the request is explicit. Create or change a placeholder file; never use Write. Call list_placeholders first. name: lowercase letters, digits, underscore, no prefix. text: the user's words verbatim when given, else your draft; a change starts from its text in list_placeholders. planText: a plan-mode part, added to the text only in Plan mode (file <name>.plan.md); draft one only when the user mentions plan mode (plan, plan mode, planning, план, планир, режим плана) or the name already has one. A change picks the part by words: plan part, plan mode, план, в режиме плана -> planText only; normal, обычн, основн -> text only; both, оба -> both; else text. An omitted part stays as it is. scope (required): a first word global or project wins; else infer it only from the words outside the placeholder's own text (global: global, everywhere, all projects, глобально, везде, во всех проектах; project: project, this project, here, this repo, в проекте, здесь, локально); a change keeps its layer from list_placeholders (global-legacy = global, project-legacy = project). That one AskUserQuestion call holds these questions in this order: 1. header "Placeholder", question exactly "Save ++<name> as drafted?" (never a layer in it) with the text, options "Save as drafted (Recommended)" / "Change it" (Other = a different name or text; apply it and save without asking again). 2. Only with a plan-mode part: header "Plan mode", question "Add this plan-mode part to ++<name>?", the draft as the first option's preview, options "Add it (Recommended)" / "No plan part". 3. Only when the scope is unclear (no word, or a new override of a plugin default): header "Where", question "Where to save ++<name>?", options "Global (Recommended)" (all your projects) then "Project" (only this project; wins over global). Only with no AskUserQuestion tool at all: save as drafted, scope global unless a word outside the text says project. Then say where it was saved.

tools.name: remove_placeholder
tools.description: Never call this tool before the user answered your one AskUserQuestion about this exact removal in this turn, even when the request is explicit; only a name with files: none in list_placeholders skips the question (a plugin default or legacy brewtools file: nothing is removed; relay the result). Remove a placeholder file from the global or project layer; never use Bash rm. The wording is free (remove, delete, drop, удали, убери, сотри). Call list_placeholders first. part: all (default; <name>.md and <name>.plan.md), plan (the plan-mode part only: plan part, plan mode, план, в режиме плана), normal (the normal text only; refused while a plan-mode part would be left without it, since that part would then be sent in every mode). scope: a first word global or project wins; else omit it and the tool takes the one layer holding the file. Question 1, header "Remove": "Remove ++<name> (<layer>)?", options "Remove it (Recommended)" / "Keep it"; when it has a plan-mode part and no part was named: "Remove ++<name> (<layer>)? It has a plan-mode part.", options "Both parts (Recommended)" / "Only the plan-mode part" / "Keep it"; when the plan part was named: "Remove the plan-mode part of ++<name> (<layer>)?", options "Remove it (Recommended)" / "Keep it". When list_placeholders shows files in both layers and no scope was given, add question 2 in the same call: header "Where", "Remove ++<name> from where?", options "Global" / "Project". Then say what is served afterwards (the result says it).

tools.name: placeholders_help
tools.description: How the user's ++ placeholders work: syntax, full text (/placeholders show ++name; the caret on a token shows up to 15 rows in the band), sending a message as typed (++/), global vs project, file format, /placeholders commands and doc links. Call it before answering any question about placeholders or the ++ prefix.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

notes: types ./types/index.d.ts declares on $: nothing (no EngineInterface member)

./register.ts hooks: session.start, turn.complete, prompt.edit, prompt.change, ui.render{component=PromptHint}, prompt.autocomplete{token=/"^[^\\w\\s]{2}"/}, prompt.submit, ui.render{component=AbovePrompt}, command.run{command=placeholders}, tool.call{tool=/"^mcp__brewmod-placeholders__"/}
